commands.command: cargo clippy -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-machine -p quansio-server --all-targets -- -D warnings  # exit captured before filtering
arch_check.py + pytest tests/architecture  # 129 passed, forbidden-wiring clean

cargo test -p quansio-qworkerd --test browser_worker --test executor --test daemon_binary --lib  # a real Chrome the worker launches, driven through the worker host against a local site whose counters show what the page really requested: loopback refused before Chrome is asked and the site never sees a request; navigate/observe/click run and the site sees exactly one click; a re-delivered click is a replay and the site still sees one; a click above the approved tier is refused with no input and goes through under a higher one; a worker without a browser refuses; bad session ids never become directories; the daemon refuses browser flags without a browser and a state dir inside the workspace

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack> cargo test -p quansio-server --test worker_browser --test worker_host --lib worker  # real PostgreSQL leases and browser sessions, a real worker session and a real Chrome: a call acts on its own run's session and run B cannot reach run A's tab by naming it; a takeover fences the agent before anything is sent and a handback lifts it; the ceiling is the taxonomy's tier (click 3, navigate 2, observe 0) and a Buy-now click above it is refused with no input; unserved browser tools are refused and open no session; no worker means WORKER_UNAVAILABLE; settle() maps ok/error/in_doubt/garbage to success/failure/unknown/unknown
cargo test -p quansio-machine --lib gateway  # approved_tier survives the wire, an unknown kind and oversize frames are refused

RUST_MIN_STACK=16777216 cargo test --no-fail-fast -p quansio-machine -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-server  # 1318 passed, 0 failed (the larger stack avoids three tests that overflow on main, reproduced without this change)

mutation checks M1-M7 all KILLED: fence removed, session_id forwarded as written, no approved tier, unserved tools routed, navigation not vetted, state dir inside the workspace accepted, in-doubt settled as success; every mutant compiles; the restored control passes. M6 first hung the suite, so the test now bounds its waits
